<subject>Reminder -- Last Day to Provide Input on Naming of Meridian Child Care Centre!</subject>
<body>
As Meridian finalises plans for our new child care centre set to open in the third quarter of next year, we’re gathering feedback on five possible names and themes for the centre. If you’ve already shared your thoughts, THANK YOU!

If not, please spare 5 minutes to visit Room 3B21 in the Corporate Wing between 11am and 1pm TODAY to share your opinion.

Feel free to bring a colleague! Complimentary refreshments will be available!

Please forward this email to any other Meridian employees who might want to contribute their ideas on the centre’s naming.

Looking forward to seeing you later today!

Regards,

Grace Elliott  
Executive Assistant  
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP  
+44 20 7946 0857  
grace.elliott@meridianlaw.com
</body>
